RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
Recalling the passage of Commend [nation]Vilita and Turori[/nation] in May 2020, which sought to commend the nation for its awe-inspiring successes and extraordinary contributions to the international sports community,
Questioning the merits of that resolution in light of an investigation conducted three years thereafter that exposed Vilita for a litany of grave and reprehensible transgressions committed against that community,
Observing that Vilita’s efforts to foster “[i]a welcoming environment[/i]” are enervated by the revelation that they themselves engaged in a behaviour that was both unbecoming of a nation considered a pillar of the international sports community and one commended by this august body:
[list][*]Vilita sent the puppet nations of [nation]United[/nation], [nation]Racing[/nation], and [nation]Esportiva[/nation] to terrorize [region]Esportiva[/region]'s regional message board. Vilita and any other nations under its control would wind up being proscribed from ever setting foot on Esportiva. [*]Esportiva’s plight was not an isolated incident, as Vilita employed the same tactics under the nation of [nation]Pirahna[/nation] to target [region]The Western Isles[/region].[/list]
Repulsed by how Vilita founded two nations which misled the community into believing other prolific nations were engaged in illegal puppetry, causing lasting damage to these nations’ credibility until evidence of their innocence came to light after the investigations:
[list][*][nation]East Neutralia[/nation], signed up for two editions of the Copa Rushmori (Editions XXX and XXXVIII), had a flag bearing resemblance to that of [region]Rushmore[/region] resident [nation]Oberour ar Moro[/nation]. [*][nation]New Old Forest[/nation], who had signed up for the Di Bradini Cup 50 immediately after its founding, was widely assumed to be an undeclared puppet of [nation]TJUN-ia[/nation].[/list]
Appalled that Vilita’s criminality does not end there, as Vilita’s worst offenses came in the form of trying to circumvent community regulations by surreptitiously sneaking puppets into multiple competitions undeclared, most notably:
[list][*]In World Cup 19 ([i]WC19[/i]), Vilita entered 11 undeclared puppets, including [nation]Crystilakere[/nation], which would go on to win WC19. Throughout the entire tournament, Vilitan sporting officials refereed each of the would-be victor’s matches. [*]In World Cup 22 ([i]WC22[/i]), Vilita entered 9 undeclared puppets, including [nation]Oaker[/nation], which finished second. Vilitan sporting officials refereed every one of Oaker’s matches except the final. [*]In World Cup 95 ([i]WC95[/i]), both of the aforementioned puppets’ appearances were declared null and void: Crystilakere’s title was declared vacated; Oaker’s final appearance met the same fate. [*]In World Cups 13 through 27, Vilita would enter 16 other undeclared nations into the competition.[/list]
Acknowledging that being granted assent to host a sporting competition anywhere across the multiverse is an honour conferred to those who have earned the trust of the wider sports community,
Saddened that Vilita had, prior to being exposed, been considered a role model to many up-and-coming nations seeking to summit the mountaintop of sporting glory, and that said aspirants sought to model themselves after Vilita,
Noting the subsequent outcry in reaction to Vilita’s shocking misdeeds, culminating in not only its shunning but its expulsion from the Executive World Cup Committee ([i]EWCC[/i]) and World Cup Committee ([i]WCC[/i]),
Therefore lamenting Vilita’s fall from grace, as the revelations of their duplicity and misconduct were not only antithetical to what was expected of such an applauded and revered nation, but also broke the hearts of an overwrought international sports community awash in a flood of unthinkable grief, incredulity, and indignation,
Laying bare the many repugnant and shameful actions committed by Vilita that are utterly antipodean to the noble virtues embodied by other nations enshrined in the pantheon of those commended by the Security Council,
HEREBY repeals “Commend Vilita and Turori.”
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Commend Vilita and Turori"
